## What's new in 1.1.0

**Guided tutorial** (`/prism-tutorial`): a sample Case Amplify case study, the same every run, through the proof in Claude Docs, design mode in Claude Design, the export and other formats. The notes are rough on purpose so you can watch the writer clean them up and the reviewer flag them.

**Case Amplify, every format**
- Sheets, brochures and 5x7 cards: no byline or footer line, the closing card's QR beside all its copy, no one-word last lines in titles or headings, and a check that pages use a variety of formats. New stacked steps and 1x4 card layouts.
- Decks: page number on the left and the logo bottom-right on every slide; dark and full purple slides.
- Posts and carousels: larger type and fewer words, no wave line or page counter, purple panels, and layout, color, photo and word-count checks.
- Films: no music and no wave, only the approved gradients, Lucide icons, few large words and a free-flowing feel. Walkthroughs open and close on the app itself, full frame, with purple tethered annotations.
